title: a premium centre for the sport wheel
lensAText: a sceptical automotive interior art director. Look at every before/after frame the builder cites with the Read tool, then take your own in ONE short Playwright script on dist/artifact.html: the seat view (setCam('cockpit')) of the Rossini GT, the Rossini Corsa and the OC Hypercar at 390x844 (a copy of dist/artifact.html with <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover"> injected; isMobile, hasTouch, DPR 3) at Night and 1280x720 Day, plus one Brio and one Vela E frame. Judge: does each wheel's centre now read as a premium, stylish, finished part at phone size (sculpted cover, machined bezel, inset badge with a thin accent ring, carbon or brushed insert), in each car's own trim, well made (no gaps, z-fighting, floating parts, the badge crisp, nothing hiding the dials or hands), and OUR OWN design with no real brand's name, logo or copied shape?
brief: THE OWNER (2026-10-27, to the hypercar session, now handed to this lane): "make the center part of the steering wheel more stylish". Together with the owner's 2026-11-09 ask for a fresh sport wheel ("looks all fresh like the AMG Alcanatra Carbon Fiber sports steering wheel Mercedes has with the button widgets attached too": our own design in that style family, no real brand names, logos, stars or copied shapes). HEAD is a9c9998 = origin/claude/sport-wheel (the reviewed sport wheel: src/preview/wheel-sport.ts + src/preview/cockpit.ts). BUILD a premium centre (hub/airbag cover) per car, phone-cheap: a sculpted cover (soft-touch leather or Alcantara look matching the car's trim), a machined/brushed bezel ring, the car's own badge inset (R for the Rossinis, V for the Vela E, the OC mark for the hypercar) with a thin accent ring in the car's colour (GT cognac, Corsa yellow, Hypercar ice blue; Brio and Vela in their own accents), and a carbon or brushed insert. The GT, Corsa and Hypercar get the full centre; the Brio and Vela E get a simpler version in their own character. Shared materials, no per-frame allocation, low tier simpler, wheel triangles within the existing budget note (+40% over c3962c5 on high). HARD LIMITS: do NOT change src/preview/spec.ts, hands*, car-wheel.ts, Physics.ts, src/onfoot/people/*; the rim and grips where the hands hold it (GRIP 32/148 deg) unchanged; the dials, thumb pads, paddles and shift lights keep working; nothing else in the cockpit changes. Extend the wheel regression check in tests/regression.mjs to assert the centre's named parts per car. PROVE: npx tsc --noEmit; npm run build (owner-test mark); npm test -- --only=boot,phone (the wheel check inside); seat-view frames Day and Night at 1280x720 and 390x844 for GT, Corsa, Hypercar and one each for Brio and Vela E, plus a close-up of each centre, BEFORE (a9c9998) and AFTER, into tests/out/sport-wheel/hub-*.png.
